title: AIIMS Rewari Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 25 Junior Resident Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rewari (AIIMS Rewari) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 25 Junior Resident Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Rewari Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
